item.title: Rian Johnson Talks ‘Knives Out,’ How He Avoided ‘Brothers Bloom’ “Movie Jail” & Why Every Film Should Feel Like A Risk
item.description: MARRAKECH FILM FESTIVAL – Rian Johnson has made three “ Knives Out ” mysteries, and he says he still starts every film as if it might not work. Speaking at an In Conversation session at the 23rd Marrakech International Film Festival, the writer-director described a career built on genre, old friends, and a refusal to repeat himself. Johnson grew up a devoted Agatha Christie fan, and he said he never approaches a genre as something to reinvent. item.description: If you’ve followed all the reporting on David Fincher ’s “ Mindhunter ”—much of which we covered intensively— and the difficulties of making it, the reasons there’s no Season 3 make perfect sense. The 90—hour work weeks required to pull it off were all-consuming, the production challenges were enormous, and worse, the series cost an exorbitant amount of money to make—so much so that the viewership simply couldn’t justify the price tag.
